body:
With this proposal we should be able to:
- create an autocomplete experience using raw widgets
- display hits from multiple indexes
- connect any autocomplete like component (with connectMultiHits)

The API seems complex but I can't imagine any other nice proposal for now so let's go forward. @mikaa123 I do also like yours but I find the one from @mthuret more flexible. having to re-state the indexName everywhere is nesting (or context) but in a more repetitive way maybe..
